name: attachment
description: File chips for prompts and messages. `Attachment` renders one file; `AttachmentList` renders a wrapping row. Display-only: upload and file-system logic stay in the consumer.
designIntent: Show what files are part of a conversation turn (name, size, type, thumbnail, upload status) without coupling the library to any upload implementation.

props.name: attachment
props.description: File descriptor: id, name, size, type, previewUrl, status.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Remove callback; omit to hide remove controls.

examples.title: Prompt attachments
examples.code: <AttachmentList attachments={[{ id: '1', name: 'spec.pdf', size: '2.4 MB', status: 'done' }]} onRemove={remove} />

antiPatterns.title: Do not use Attachment for drag-and-drop targets
antiPatterns.explanation: The chip displays an existing item; build dropzones in the consumer and render AttachmentList once items exist.

accessibility.implementation: Icon-only remove button has an aria-label including the file name.
Uploading state is announced via role=status.
Preview images are aria-hidden; the file name carries the meaning.
